// MEET PREEM //

The Face of the Grid

GRID//NODE finally has a face. PREEM is the wolverine who watches your grid around the clock, guarding every logged shot, every phase, every record. Your biology, under watch.

Why GRID//NODE Exists

Protocol tracking is often spread across notes, screenshots, spreadsheets, calendars, and memory.

GRID//NODE begins with GLP-1 protocol tracking, then extends that record into a broader Personal Biotech Operating System for user-entered health protocol data.

Beyond GLP-1s, GRID//NODE organizes peptide research records, metabolic tracking, and user-entered protocol history — all in one place, all on your device.

The System

HOME

Your Phase Engine command view.

HOME shows your current phase estimate, protocol curve, and next actions, all grounded in your own logged records.

SHOTS

Record GLP-1 protocol events in a structured SHOTS history.

Log timing, locations, and notes so each user-entered SHOT adds signal to the rest of GRID//NODE.

RESULTS

Understand outcomes from your own recorded protocol history.

RESULTS turns logged SHOTS, weight, symptoms, and notes into outcome-tracking context over time.

LAB

Biotech utility tools for organizing protocol information.

LAB is a restrained utility layer for calculators, unit conversions, and educational tools, not medical direction.

VAULT

Your secure personal data core.

VAULT keeps identity, protocol context, settings, and your data ownership controls in one protected place.

Build Your Grid

Your shots, your weight, your phases. Synced across every device when you sign in.

Built With Purpose

GRID//NODE began as one person trying to understand his own biological timeline. It is being built carefully, independently, and with respect for the people who trust it with their data.

SCOPE

GRID//NODE is a tracking and educational intelligence system.

GRID//NODE is not a doctor, diagnosis system, treatment system, prescribing tool, or dosing authority.

GRID//NODE does not sell, source, or facilitate peptide purchases.

PRIVACY + DATA OWNERSHIP

GRID//NODE stores your record on this device by default. If you connect a cloud account, the workspace is associated with that account so recovery and synchronization can occur.

You can export your records and choose whether to use cloud recovery. GRID//NODE is not a diagnostic or clinical records service.

TERMS OF USE

GRID//NODE provides tracking and educational intelligence for user-entered records. You remain responsible for the accuracy of entries and for medical decisions.

Do not use GRID//NODE as a substitute for a licensed clinician, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, or dosing guidance.

    Dose (mg) The dose amount entered by the user, measured in milligrams.

    Concentration (mg/mL) How many milligrams are present in each milliliter of liquid, based on the user-entered vial label.

    Volume (mL) The calculated liquid volume from dose divided by concentration.

    Units For a U-100 syringe, 1 mL equals 100 units. Example: 0.50 mL equals 50 units.

    PRIVACY POLICY

    Effective September 12, 2026

    GRID//NODE is local-first. Your data lives on this device unless you choose cloud sync. This policy explains what is stored, where it goes, and the rights you always keep.

    LOCAL-FIRST STORAGE

    By default, everything you enter stays in this device's local storage. Nothing is transmitted anywhere, to anyone, until you connect a cloud account.

    WHAT IS STORED

    Your shot log (medication, dose, date, time, injection site, notes), weight entries, body measurements, side-effect observations, device registry entries, and app settings. All of it is user-entered by you.

    OPTIONAL CLOUD SYNC

    If you sign in with Google or email, your workspace syncs to your private cloud account for backup and multi-device access. Cloud sync is entirely optional — GRID//NODE works fully without it, forever.

    YOUR EXPORT RIGHTS

    Export your records as CSV or a complete backup at any time from VAULT → YOUR DATA. Your records are yours, in readable formats, with no lock-in.

    YOUR DELETE RIGHTS

    Delete all local data from VAULT → YOUR DATA at any time. If you use cloud sync, you can also delete your cloud account and its server copy. Deletion is permanent.

    NOT A SOURCE

    GRID//NODE does not sell, source, or facilitate peptide purchases. It is a tracking tool only.

    NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

    GRID//NODE does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or dosing guidance. Always consult a licensed clinician for medical decisions.
